title: About Endpoint Data Scan Sensitive Information: Share Files Externally

blocks.text: Endpoint DLP monitors and protects files intended for external use. Sharing is managed through a secure workflow where administrators define both the users permitted to share data and the recipient's domains authorized to receive it. This ensures that sensitive information remains secure and accessible only to the intended parties when it is outside the organization. An authorized user can right-click the desired file on their endpoint, and select Zscaler > Share Files Externally to protect files. To decrypt the file, the user must download and use the ZscalerSecure File Viewer tool. To learn more, see Understanding Sharing Files Externally.
This feature encrypts files without automatically sharing them with external recipients, allowing you to share the protected files via email or removable storage or any other method.
The Share Files Externally page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Maintain persistent encryption for sensitive data, ensuring protection even after it is shared outside your organization.
Restrict visibility to preauthorized recipients, significantly reducing the risk of accidental data exposure.
Facilitate secure access for external partners through a simplified One-Time Password (OTP) workflow using the Zscaler Secure File Viewer.

blocks.text: On the Share Files Externally page (Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint Data Scan > Sensitive Information > Share Files Externally), you can view the following:

blocks.item: Settings: Click to view the Settings page. You can configure recipient domains and the users who can share files externally. You can also view the recipient domain details and user details in the respective tabs. To learn more, see Configuring Share Files Externally Settings.
Filter files shared externally by File Name and Owner.
In the table, view a list of all the files shared and related information:
File Name: The original name of the file that was encrypted and shared externally.
Owner: The internal user who initiated the sharing process for the file.
Shared With: The list of external email recipients authorized to decrypt and view the file.
Shared On: The specific date and time the file was encrypted for external sharing.
DLP Engines: The DLP that identified sensitive data matches within the shared file.
AI & ML Categories: The classifications assigned to the file by Zscaler's artificial intelligence and machine learning models.
Modify the table and its columns.
Customize Columns: Select, deselect, or reorder the data fields displayed in the table.
Click the Edit icon to view details of the file shared, (i.e., File Name, Owner, Shared on, DLP Engines, AI & ML Categories, and Shared With). You can also view the following information:
Recipients: View the recipient email details.
